trouble.step.passport.search.title: Search once more, calmly
trouble.step.passport.search.body: Check bags, pockets, the room safe and the last places you were. Ask the front desk and any venue you visited.
trouble.step.passport.report.title: Report it to the police
trouble.step.passport.report.body: Ask for a written report or a reference number. Your embassy and insurer may ask for it.
trouble.step.passport.embassy.title: Contact your embassy or consulate
trouble.step.passport.embassy.body: Tell them it is lost or stolen and ask about an emergency travel document: what to bring, opening hours and whether you need an appointment. Ask how to cancel the old passport.
trouble.step.passport.copy.title: Find your passport copy
trouble.step.passport.copy.body: A photo or copy of the photo page makes the paperwork faster.
trouble.step.passport.photos.title: Get passport photos
trouble.step.passport.photos.body: Ask the embassy which size and background they need before you have them taken.
trouble.step.passport.proof.title: Gather other proof of who you are
trouble.step.passport.proof.body: A driving licence or other ID, plus your travel bookings, can help prove who you are and why you need to travel.
trouble.step.passport.airline.title: Tell your airline if you fly soon
trouble.step.passport.airline.body: Ask whether your booking needs the new document’s details, or whether you need to change the date.
trouble.step.passport.insurer.title: Tell your insurer
trouble.step.passport.insurer.body: Keep receipts for the new document, photos, travel to the embassy and any changed bookings.
trouble.step.card.block.title: Block the card now
trouble.step.card.block.body: Call your bank’s card block line, or freeze the card in your banking app. Do it even if you think it is only misplaced.
trouble.step.card.others.title: Check what else was with it
trouble.step.card.others.body: If a wallet or bag went, block every card that was in it, and note any ID that went too.
trouble.step.card.payments.title: Look for payments you don’t recognise
trouble.step.card.payments.body: Tell the bank about each one and ask how to dispute them. Write down the date, time and who you spoke to.
trouble.step.card.police.title: Report a theft to the police
trouble.step.card.police.body: If it was stolen, your bank or insurer may ask for a police report or reference number.
trouble.step.card.backup.title: Switch to your backup money
trouble.step.card.backup.body: A spare card, cash kept somewhere else, or a phone wallet you set up before the trip.
trouble.step.card.replace.title: Ask about a replacement abroad
trouble.step.card.replace.body: Some banks can send a replacement card or arrange emergency cash. Ask where it can be delivered and how long it takes.
trouble.step.card.passwords.title: Change passwords if notes or a phone went too
trouble.step.card.passwords.body: Start with online banking and your email, from a device you trust.
trouble.step.phone.ring.title: Call your own number
trouble.step.phone.ring.body: Use a friend’s phone. It may be nearby, or someone honest may answer.
trouble.step.phone.locate.title: Use your phone’s find-my-device service
trouble.step.phone.locate.body: Sign in from a laptop, tablet or a friend’s phone to see it on a map or play a sound.
trouble.step.phone.lost.title: Mark it as lost
trouble.step.phone.lost.body: Lock it and show a message with a number to reach you. If it shows somewhere you don’t know, don’t go there alone: tell the police.
trouble.step.phone.sim.title: Ask your mobile provider to block the SIM
trouble.step.phone.sim.body: This stops calls, and texts with sign-in codes, going to whoever has it. Ask about a replacement SIM.
trouble.step.phone.passwords.title: Change key passwords from another device
trouble.step.phone.passwords.body: Email first, then banking and messaging. Sign out of sessions you don’t recognise.
trouble.step.phone.bank.title: Tell your bank if banking apps or cards were on it
trouble.step.phone.bank.body: Ask them to watch the account or block cards stored on the phone.
trouble.step.phone.police.title: Get a police report if it was stolen
trouble.step.phone.police.body: Bring the phone’s serial or device number if you have it: it is on the box, the receipt or your account.
trouble.step.phone.erase.title: Erase it only once you give up on it
trouble.step.phone.erase.body: Erasing protects your data, but afterwards you may no longer be able to see where it is.
trouble.step.theft.safe.title: Get somewhere safe first
trouble.step.theft.safe.body: You matter more than your things. Don’t chase anyone. If you are hurt or in danger, call the emergency number.
trouble.step.theft.list.title: Write down what was taken
trouble.step.theft.list.body: Each item, a rough value, and when and where it happened. Photos or receipts of the items help.
trouble.step.theft.station.title: Find the right police station
trouble.step.theft.station.body: Ask your accommodation which station takes reports from visitors. Some places have tourist police.
trouble.step.theft.language.title: Get help with the language
trouble.step.theft.language.body: Ask whether an interpreter or an English-speaking officer is available. Show a phrase card if words fail.
trouble.step.theft.written.title: Ask for a written report
trouble.step.theft.written.body: It should have a reference number, the date and the list of items. Check the details before you sign.
trouble.step.theft.copy.title: Keep a copy safe
trouble.step.theft.copy.body: Photograph the report and keep it with your travel documents.
trouble.step.theft.insurer.title: Tell your insurer quickly
trouble.step.theft.insurer.body: Many policies have a time limit for reporting a theft. Ask exactly what they need from you.
trouble.step.theft.cards.title: Block cards and change passwords
trouble.step.theft.cards.body: If cards, a phone or a laptop were taken, block them now rather than later.
trouble.step.flight.airline.title: Talk to the airline straight away
trouble.step.flight.airline.body: Go to the transfer or ticket desk. Calling while you queue can be quicker.
trouble.step.flight.booking.title: Check how you booked
trouble.step.flight.booking.body: A missed connection on one booking is often rebooked by the airline. Separate tickets may mean buying a new one.
trouble.step.flight.options.title: Ask about every option
trouble.step.flight.options.body: Later flights, partner airlines, nearby airports, or a train for part of the way.
trouble.step.flight.care.title: Ask what help they offer while you wait
trouble.step.flight.care.body: For long waits, airlines may offer meals or a hotel. Ask before you pay yourself.
trouble.step.flight.receipts.title: Keep every receipt
trouble.step.flight.receipts.body: Meals, transport, a hotel and any new tickets, plus the airline’s written confirmation of the delay.
trouble.step.flight.stay.title: Tell your accommodation
trouble.step.flight.stay.body: Let them know you will arrive late or not at all, so you don’t lose the booking.
trouble.step.flight.insurer.title: Check your travel insurance
trouble.step.flight.insurer.body: Some policies cover missed departures or delays. Ask what they need for a claim.
trouble.step.bag.desk.title: Report it before leaving the airport
trouble.step.bag.desk.body: Go to the baggage service desk in the arrivals hall before you pass through the exit.
trouble.step.bag.reference.title: Get a file reference
trouble.step.bag.reference.body: Ask for a written report with a reference number. Keep your bag tag and boarding pass.
trouble.step.bag.describe.title: Describe the bag well
trouble.step.bag.describe.body: Colour, size, type, any marks or ribbons, and one unusual item inside.
trouble.step.bag.address.title: Give a delivery address
trouble.step.bag.address.body: Where you are staying and for which dates, plus a phone number that works abroad.
trouble.step.bag.essentials.title: Ask about essentials
trouble.step.bag.essentials.body: Ask what basics the airline covers while you wait, and keep the receipts.
trouble.step.bag.follow.title: Follow up
trouble.step.bag.follow.body: Use the reference to check progress. Note every call: date, time and who you spoke to.
trouble.step.bag.insurer.title: Tell your insurer if it doesn’t turn up
trouble.step.bag.insurer.body: Send the airline report and receipts. Check whether the airline must answer first.
trouble.step.medical.emergency.title: In an emergency, call an ambulance
trouble.step.medical.emergency.body: Chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding or a bad fall: call first, everything else can wait.
trouble.step.medical.insurer.title: Call your insurer’s assistance line early
trouble.step.medical.insurer.body: Many policies ask you to call before treatment that isn’t an emergency. They can point you to a clinic.
trouble.step.medical.where.title: Find the right place
trouble.step.medical.where.body: A pharmacy for minor problems, a clinic or hospital for anything more.
trouble.step.medical.explain.title: Show what you need
trouble.step.medical.explain.body: A phrase card helps when you can’t explain in the local language.
trouble.step.medical.details.title: Have your medical details ready
trouble.step.medical.details.body: Allergies, medicines and conditions. Your emergency card keeps private medical notes on this phone.
trouble.step.medical.papers.title: Keep every document
trouble.step.medical.papers.body: Receipts, prescriptions and the doctor’s report. Your insurer will ask for them.
trouble.step.medical.home.title: Tell someone at home
trouble.step.medical.home.body: Let an emergency contact know where you are and how to reach you.
trouble.step.scam.safe.title: Stay calm and safe
trouble.step.scam.safe.body: Don’t let an argument escalate. If you feel unsafe, pay, leave and report it afterwards.
trouble.step.scam.details.title: Note the details
trouble.step.scam.details.body: Taxi or plate number, driver ID, shop or seller name, time and place. Take a photo if it is safe to.
trouble.step.scam.receipt.title: Ask for a receipt
trouble.step.scam.receipt.body: A written receipt makes a complaint or a dispute possible.
trouble.step.scam.card.title: Card charged wrongly? Call your bank
trouble.step.scam.card.body: Ask how to dispute the payment, and block the card if its details may have been copied.
trouble.step.scam.tickets.title: Fake tickets: keep the evidence
trouble.step.scam.tickets.body: Keep what you were given and any messages from the seller. Next time, buy from the official seller.
trouble.step.scam.report.title: Report it
trouble.step.scam.report.body: To the police or tourist police, and to the taxi firm, venue or platform involved.
trouble.step.scam.hotel.title: Ask your accommodation for help
trouble.step.scam.hotel.body: Front desks know the local tricks and can often help you report it or call someone.
